_notes: Rules are per-faculty and cover undergraduate degrees only.
'No double-counting' rule applies universally: a course cannot satisfy two programs simultaneously.
Credit counts are approximate guidelines; specific department requirements may vary.
Professional faculties (Law, Medicine, Dentistry, Music) have fixed curricula — minors are rare/not applicable.
Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies students are excluded from these rules.

Faculty of Arts.structure: Multi-track: students must combine at least two program components.

majors.notes: A second major can substitute for the required minor. Double-majors are common.

minors.notes: Required if only one major is declared. Up to 2 minors allowed. At least one program must be from the Faculty of Arts (as of Fall 2025).

honours.notes: Honours replaces the major; a minor is still recommended.

Faculty of Science.structure: Flexible: Liberal, Major, or Honours streams.

majors.notes: Double major is permitted but must total at least 120 credits without double-counting.

minors.notes: Optional for Major stream. Liberal stream requires a breadth component (18+ credits) which can be a minor.

liberal_stream.notes: Breadth can be fulfilled by a Minor, Arts Major/Minor, or a second Core Science Component.

Faculty of Engineering.structure: Professional fixed curriculum. Minors are optional add-ons that may extend degree length.

majors.notes: One engineering discipline only (e.g., Software, Electrical, Mechanical). Cannot double-major.

minors.notes: Optional. Adds credits to the degree. Common minors: Computer Science, Management, Biomedical Engineering.

Desautels Faculty of Management.structure: Core business curriculum with a required major concentration in Year 3-4.

majors.notes: One major concentration required (e.g., Finance, Marketing, Accounting). Cannot double-major within Commerce.

minors.notes: Optional. Must be from outside Commerce core. Popular choices: Economics, Psychology, Computer Science.

Faculty of Agricultural and Environmenta.degree: B.Sc.(Ag.Env.Sc.) or B.Sc.(Nutrition) or B.Sc.(Environmental Science)
Faculty of Agricultural and Environmenta.structure: Varies by program. Some programs are structured; others allow elective flexibility.

majors.notes: Typically one major. Some programs (e.g., Environment options) have a flexible specialization track.

minors.notes: Optional. Must not overlap with required coursework.

Faculty of Education.structure: Professional teacher training degree. Fixed curriculum with a teachable subject area.

majors.notes: One teachable subject (e.g., Physical Education, Education in Global Contexts). Cannot double-major.

minors.notes: Rare. Most students do not add a formal minor due to the heavy required curriculum.

Faculty of Law.structure: Fixed professional curriculum. No major/minor system.
Faculty of Law.notes: Specialized professional degree. No room for additional majors or minors.

Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences.notes: Students in pre-med or nursing tracks may take minors during their B.Sc. pre-requisite years.

Schulich School of Music.structure: Structured music curriculum. Limited room for additional programs.

majors.notes: One music discipline (e.g., Performance, Music Education, Musicology).

minors.notes: Occasionally added, but heavy practice/studio load makes this uncommon.

School of Continuing Studies.structure: Non-standard. Continuing education certificates and professional development programs.
School of Continuing Studies.notes: Not applicable to traditional undergraduate major/minor system.

Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies.structure: Graduate programs. No major/minor system at this level.
Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies.notes: Out of scope for this application.

universal_rules.no_double_counting: A single course cannot fulfill the requirements of more than one program or concentration.
universal_rules.program_declaration: Students must declare their program(s) through Minerva during designated periods.

gpa_requirements.honours: Minimum 3.0 CGPA typically required to enter or remain in an Honours program.
gpa_requirements.general: Students below 2.0 CGPA may be placed on probation.

graduation_requirements.minimum_upper_level: At least 60 credits must be at the 300-level or above.
